detail.longDescription: Flow 0.7.1 is here! This update is mostly about making the existing features easier to use, especially when managing calendars from different sources. Highlights: 📅 Better calendar source management 🔗 Easier source setup and read-only handling ⚙️ Updated settings and navigation 📦 More reliable and reproducible builds Read more here: https://www. linwood.dev/flow/0.7.1/ # opensource # productivity # flutter
